defeats.how: Plantman's wooden doubles replaced the S.H.I.E.L.D. agents at the base and took Fury and Reagan prisoner.
defeats.evidence: Nick Fury and President Ronald Reagan are taken prisoner by doubles who have replaced the S.H.I.E.L.D. agents assigned to the installation

defeats.how: The Avengers swiftly attacked the base, found the fake agents were Plantman's wooden facsimiles and rescued the prisoners.
defeats.evidence: The Avengers are called in and swiftly attack the base
